changelog: Splash Studio Canvas Fix: Added explicit path encapsulation to prevent path retention artifacts when loading custom disk images
Bundled Windows MSIX Tools: makeappx.exe, signtool.exe, and mssign32.dll embedded directly into core assembly to allow MSIX builds without Windows SDK
Website Integration: Added live interactive Splash Studio brand builder and simulator to wildcatstudio.us
Zero-Clutter Packaging: Standalone single-file bundle with zero loose DLLs in root
